text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0835 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.60 to C$1.10 a tonne up on firm CBOT soybean calls despite ideal growing conditions on Canada's Prairies. July WCE futures crush margin fell to +3.97 Friday from +7.40 Thursday. The Canadian Oilseed Processors' Association on Friday said 61,158 tonnes of canola were crushed in the previous week, a bullishly-construed crushing level. Canada's dollar was flat at C$1.3776 versus the U.S. dollar, rose to 84.64 Japanese Yen and rose to 1.2528 German Marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.30 to C$0.80 a tonne up on allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 up on CBOT corn calls despite ideal growing conditions on Canada's Prairies.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.30 to C$0.80 up on U.S. corn and wheat calls.
FEED PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 up on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
